repo_notes.content: This repository uses a multi-agent development framework. The .ai/ directory contains all shared project memory: task tracking (tasks/), architectural decisions (memory/decisions.md), project state (memory/context.md), tech stack (memory/stack.md), feature specs (features/), bug tracking (bugs/), and cost tracking (costs/). The .devin/ directory holds the Devin wiring: an always-on mode router (rules/agent-workflow.md) and the developer subagent profile (agents/developer.md).
repo_notes.author: Project Setup

repo_notes.content: Agent roles: in autonomous mode a single orchestrator session (frontier model) performs Architect duties and dispatches one developer subagent per task (pinned cheaper model); in supervised mode the user pastes .ai/roles/architect.md or developer.md into separate sessions. The Architect contract lives in .ai/roles/ — decomposition, reviews, all .ai/ writes — and the Developer contract is .ai/roles/developer.md, executed verbatim by the subagent.
repo_notes.author: Project Setup
